items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: And Leo Mosley is still jobbing in New York. He's doing a fantastic job.

ctx.x: But did he break his band up or were they going to decline or what?
Well, his band broke up in the early 30s. And one of his men just recently died in New York, Crook, the banjo player. And Leo Mosley is still jobbing in New York. He's doing a fantastic job.
What about a band like Trent? I've heard of Trent's number two band somewhere.
